items.question: Pełne otwarcie skrzydeł
items.ok: Vents and windows opened fully upon manual activation.
items.fail: Vents and windows failed to reach the fully open position upon manual activation.

reasons.label: Actuator fault
reasons.text: Electric actuator failed to drive the vent mechanism – replacement or reset required.

reasons.label: Mechanical obstruction
reasons.text: Physical obstruction prevented the vent from opening completely.

items.question: Działanie przycisków ROP
items.ok: Local manual call point successfully initiated the opening signal.
items.fail: Manual call point failed to trigger the system response.

reasons.label: Wiring fault
reasons.text: Communication break between call point and control panel.

items.question: Stan siłowników elektrycznych/pneumatycznych
items.ok: Actuators are securely mounted and free from visible damage.
items.fail: Actuators show physical damage, loose mountings, or defects.

reasons.label: Loose mounting
reasons.text: Actuator brackets or fixings have become loose.

items.question: Uszczelki i ramy okienne
items.ok: Gaskets and window frames are clean, flexible, and seal properly.
items.fail: Gaskets are damaged, worn, or frames compromised.

reasons.label: Seal wear
reasons.text: Perished or damaged seals preventing a tight close.

items.question: Drogi dojścia i brak przeszkód
items.ok: Access paths and vent surroundings are clear of obstructions.
items.fail: Obstructions found blocking the vents or access paths.

reasons.label: Blocked access
reasons.text: Items stored obstructing the vent area.

items.question: Procedura resetu i zamknięcia
items.ok: System reset successfully and vents closed tightly via actuators.
items.fail: System failed to reset or close completely.

reasons.label: Control latch error
reasons.text: Panel failed to send close command post-reset.

items.question: Stan obudowy i czystość
items.ok: ATS enclosure is clean internally and externally with no damage.
items.fail: ATS enclosure shows dirt accumulation or physical damage.

reasons.label: Physical damage
reasons.text: Dents or cracks found on the enclosure body.

items.question: Szczelność drzwi i zamków
items.ok: Enclosure doors close securely with functional locks and intact seals.
items.fail: Doors fail to seal properly or locks are defective.

reasons.label: Broken lock
reasons.text: Door latch or lock mechanism failure.

items.question: Stan dławików i kabli
items.ok: Cable glands are tight, secured, and cabling is undamaged.
items.fail: Loose cable glands or damaged cabling identified.

reasons.label: Loose gland
reasons.text: Cable entry gland has loosened, compromising entry protection.

items.question: Brak wilgoci i kondensacji
items.ok: Interior of the ATS enclosure is dry with no moisture or foreign bodies.
items.fail: Moisture, condensation, or foreign bodies present inside.

reasons.label: Moisture ingress
reasons.text: Water droplets or condensation pooling inside the panel.

items.question: Wskazania wyświetlacza sterownika
items.ok: ATS microprocessor controller is operational with no active error codes.
items.fail: Controller displays active faults, errors, or warning indicators.

reasons.label: Controller fault
reasons.text: Internal diagnostic alarm triggered on the ATS controller.

items.question: Poprawność parametrów zasilania
items.ok: Incoming voltages and frequencies are within nominal operating parameters.
items.fail: Voltage or frequency levels out of acceptable tolerance range.

reasons.label: Voltage sag
reasons.text: Utility supply voltage dropped below acceptable operational thresholds.

items.question: Porządek i brak materiałów łatwopalnych
items.ok: Plant room is clean, tidy, and free of combustible materials.
items.fail: Combustible materials or rubbish stored improperly in the plant room.

reasons.label: Poor housekeeping
reasons.text: Cardboard or waste left near electrical panels or machinery.

items.question: Drogi ewakuacyjne i przejścia
items.ok: Walkways and escape routes to all equipment are clear.
items.fail: Access routes blocked by equipment or obstructions.

reasons.label: Blocked path
reasons.text: Objects stored blocking safe passage to plant equipment.

items.question: Oświetlenie ogólne i awaryjne
items.ok: General lighting and emergency lights in the plant room are fully operational.
items.fail: Lighting units failed or damaged in the plant room.

reasons.label: Lamp failure
reasons.text: Luminaire bulb or LED unit burned out.

items.question: Sprawność gaśnic i sprzętu ppoż.
items.ok: Fire extinguishers are inspected, in place, and unobstructed.
items.fail: Fire safety equipment missing, expired, or blocked.

reasons.label: Blocked extinguisher
reasons.text: Fire extinguisher is obstructed by equipment.

items.question: Stan pomp i silników (wibracje/hałas)
items.ok: Pumps and motors run smoothly with no abnormal vibration or noise.
items.fail: Excessive noise or abnormal vibration detected on pumps or motors.

reasons.label: Worn bearings
reasons.text: Motor bearings showing signs of mechanical failure.

items.question: Szczelność rurociągów i armatury
items.ok: Pipework, valves, and joints are sound with no leaks.
items.fail: Leaks or weeping joints found on pipework or valves.

reasons.label: Joint leak
reasons.text: Water leaking from threaded or flanged pipe joint.

items.question: Działanie opraw oświetleniowych
items.ok: All general lighting luminaires illuminate correctly with no failures.
items.fail: One or more luminaires failed to illuminate.

reasons.label: Lamp failure
reasons.text: LED module or bulb is blown.

items.question: Brak efektu migotania
items.ok: Lighting output is stable with no flickering or dimming issues.
items.fail: Flickering or unstable light output observed.

reasons.label: Driver fault
reasons.text: LED driver failing, causing light flicker.

items.question: Stan kloszy i obudów
items.ok: Diffusers, covers, and casings are clean and undamaged.
items.fail: Diffusers cracked, dirty, or damaged.

reasons.label: Physical damage
reasons.text: Cracked plastic diffuser cover.

items.question: Pewność mocowania
items.ok: Luminaires are securely mounted to ceilings or walls.
items.fail: Luminaires loose or sagging from mountings.

reasons.label: Loose fixing
reasons.text: Mounting screws or brackets have slipped.

items.question: Stan okablowania i puszek
items.ok: Visible wiring and junction boxes are secure and properly enclosed.
items.fail: Exposed wiring or damaged junction boxes observed.

reasons.label: Damaged conduit
reasons.text: Cable protection conduit or box cover missing.

items.question: Stan zewnętrzny obudowy rozdzielnicy
items.ok: Distribution board enclosure and doors are secure and undamaged.
items.fail: Enclosure doors or body damaged or unsecure.

reasons.label: Hitch damage
reasons.text: Cabinet door hinge damaged.

items.question: Obecność tablic ostrzegawczych
items.ok: Required electrical warning labels are present and legible.
items.fail: Warning labels missing or faded.

reasons.label: Missing label
reasons.text: Danger 400V warning sticker missing from door exterior.

items.question: Czystość i brak zanieczyszczeń wewnątrz
items.ok: Interior of the distribution board is clean and free of debris.
items.fail: Dust, dirt, or debris found inside the distribution board.

reasons.label: Dust accumulation
reasons.text: Construction dust or debris inside the enclosure.

items.question: Stan aparatur modułowych (MCB, RCD, RCBO)
items.ok: Modular switchgear devices are intact with no discoloration or cracks.
items.fail: Switchgear devices show signs of damage, melting, or discoloration.

reasons.label: Thermal damage
reasons.text: Discoloration on module casing indicating overheating.
